name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline. It sharpens fine details in still frames better than generic upscalers, giving us a measurable quality bump without extra compute. Trade-off: it adds one extra step to the workflow, but the gain in clarity outweighs the minor slowdown.

name: Torque
text: Depth-aware upscaling won’t fix EXCAVA’s motion blur—it’s a temporal artifact, not a spatial one. The real risk is wasting effort on a tool that targets the wrong problem. VFI-Flow’s 20-30% compute hit is a gamble, but it directly attacks the temporal bottleneck; test it first on a 10-second clip with measurable blur metrics before committing.
